270-`cloudflare.agents.agent.id` (the named instance, omitted when the name is not
271-yet readable during construction), and `cloudflare.agents.operation.name`
272:(`agent_initialization`). Like the rest of the tracing in this package, it is a
273:no-op when the runtime has no native tracing capability.
274-
275:## AI SDK tracing
276-
277:`agents/observability/ai` instruments the Vercel AI SDK with Workers' native
278-custom spans. It projects the scalar subset supported by the Workers `Span` API
279-onto the current
280-[OpenTelemetry GenAI semantic conventions](https://github.com/open-telemetry/semantic-conventions-genai).
281-Spans flow to Workers Observability and configured OTLP destinations. The
282:integration is a no-op when the runtime has no native tracing capability.
283-
284-**Think agents are traced out of the box.** Enable
285-`observability.traces.enabled` in `wrangler.jsonc`; no Think option is required.
286-A turn gets an `invoke_agent {agent class}` operation span, `chat {model}` model
287-spans, and `execute_tool {tool}` spans. Think always supplies its durable
288-identity: `gen_ai.agent.name` is the class name, `gen_ai.agent.id` is the named
289-instance, and `gen_ai.conversation.id` is the opaque Durable Object ID. These
290-are defaults; `beforeTurn` can override `functionId` or the corresponding
291-metadata fields for applications with a different identity model. Payload
292-storage is off by default. Set `storeMessages` and/or `storeTools` on the Think
293-agent to opt in; these are wrapper settings, not span attributes.
294-
295:### AI SDK v6 and v7
296-
297-Wrap the SDK namespace and call the wrapped functions:
298-
299-```ts
300-import * as ai from "ai";
301-import { wrapAISDK } from "agents/observability/ai";
302-
303-const { generateText, streamText } = wrapAISDK(ai);
304-```
305-
306:`wrapAISDK` supports AI SDK v6 and v7. It instruments `generateText`,
307-`streamText`, `generateObject`, and `streamObject`. You do not need to register a
308:telemetry integration for Agents tracing on AI SDK v7.
309-
310-Span names use `{operation} {target}` and fall back to the bare operation past
311-64 UTF-8 bytes; the full target remains on its semantic attribute. A model
312-object is wrapped with the SDK's `wrapLanguageModel` helper, so provider work is
313-a `chat {model}` child of the `invoke_agent {agent}` operation span. Tool
314-execution is wrapped as `execute_tool {tool}`. Approval lifecycle segments
315-appear as bounded `tool_approval {tool}` children of an `execute_tool {tool}`
316-span, correlated by `gen_ai.tool.call.id` and carrying
317-`cloudflare.agents.tool.approval.state` (`requested`, `approved`, or `denied`).
318-They never remain open while waiting for a human across invocations. Stream
319-spans close on completion, cancellation, an in-band error, or early consumer
320-return. Async-generator tools stay open until iteration ends.
321-
322-Pass `storeMessages: true` to write full input/output message arrays to `chat`.
323-The JSON follows the OpenTelemetry GenAI schemas: messages use `{ role, parts }`,
324-text and reasoning parts use `{ type, content }`, tool parts use `tool_call` /
325-`tool_call_response`, and every output message includes `finish_reason`. Pass
326-`storeTools: true` to write tool arguments and results to `execute_tool`:
327-
328-```ts
329-const traced = wrapAISDK(ai, {
330-  storeMessages: true,
331-  storeTools: true
332-});
333-```
334-
335-When a gateway-backed provider exposes its AI Gateway log ID through response
336-headers, provider metadata, or the Workers AI binding, the corresponding
337-`chat` span includes `cloudflare.ai_gateway.log.id`. The attribute is omitted
338-when no actual response exposes an ID; the wrapper does not infer one or make an
339-extra request.
340-
341-### Identity
342-
343:The AI SDK's canonical OpenTelemetry integration maps `functionId` to
344-`gen_ai.agent.name`. For direct `wrapAISDK` calls, `functionId` should therefore
345-be a low-cardinality logical agent name, not a request, user, session, or
346-Durable Object identifier. In v6, the other identity values are read from
347-`experimental_telemetry.metadata`; an explicit `agentName` takes precedence
348-over `functionId`.
349-
350-Think sets all three fields automatically on every inference:
351-
352-```text
353-gen_ai.agent.name      = this.constructor.name
354-gen_ai.agent.id        = this.name
355-gen_ai.conversation.id = this.ctx.id.toString()
356-```
357-
358-For direct v6 wrapper calls, supply identity explicitly:
359-
360-```ts
361-await generateText({
362-  model,
363-  prompt: "...",
364-  experimental_telemetry: {
365-    functionId: "booking-agent",
366-    metadata: {
367-      // Stable agent resource/instance identifier.
368-      agentId: "asst_123",
369-      agentVersion: "2026-07-01",
370-      conversationId: "conversation-123"
371-    }
372-  }
373-});
374-```
375-
376:AI SDK v7 has no telemetry metadata bag. Put additional identity in
377-`runtimeContext` and explicitly include those fields:
378-
379-```ts
380-await generateText({
381-  model,
382-  prompt: "...",
383-  runtimeContext: {
384-    conversationId: "conversation-123"
385-  },
386-  telemetry: {
387-    functionId: "booking-agent",
388-    includeRuntimeContext: {
389-      conversationId: true
390-    }
391-  }
392-});
393-```
394-
395-### Emitted data
396-
397-| Standard attributes                                                                | Source and scope                                                                             |
398-| ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
399-| `gen_ai.operation.name`                                                            | `invoke_agent`, `chat`, or `execute_tool` on every span                                      |
400-| `gen_ai.agent.id`, `gen_ai.agent.name`, `gen_ai.agent.version`                     | Explicit operation identity; Think defaults ID and name, but not version                     |
401-| `gen_ai.conversation.id`                                                           | Explicit operation conversation; Think defaults to its opaque Durable Object ID              |
402-| `gen_ai.provider.name`                                                             | Normalized provider on operation/model spans when known                                      |
403-| `gen_ai.output.type`                                                               | Requested `text` or `json` output on operation/model spans                                   |
404-| `gen_ai.request.model`                                                             | Requested model when known                                                                   |
405-| `gen_ai.request.frequency_penalty`, `gen_ai.request.presence_penalty`              | Numeric request settings when supplied                                                       |
406-| `gen_ai.request.max_tokens`, `gen_ai.request.seed`, `gen_ai.request.top_k`         | Integer request settings when supplied                                                       |
407-| `gen_ai.request.stream`                                                            | `true` on streaming operations; omitted otherwise                                            |
408-| `gen_ai.request.temperature`, `gen_ai.request.top_p`                               | Numeric request settings when supplied                                                       |
409-| `gen_ai.response.id`, `gen_ai.response.model`                                      | Model-call response metadata when actually reported; never inferred from the requested model |
410-| `gen_ai.response.time_to_first_chunk`                                              | Model-call streaming latency in seconds                                                      |
411-| `gen_ai.usage.input_tokens`, `gen_ai.usage.output_tokens`                          | Aggregate usage on operations and per-call usage on model spans                              |
412-| `gen_ai.usage.cache_creation.input_tokens`, `gen_ai.usage.cache_read.input_tokens` | Provider cache usage when reported                                                           |
413-| `gen_ai.usage.reasoning.output_tokens`                                             | Reasoning output usage when reported                                                         |
414-| `gen_ai.tool.name`, `gen_ai.tool.type`, `gen_ai.tool.call.id`                      | Tool identity; call ID also correlates approval lifecycle segments                           |
415-| `cloudflare.agents.tool.approval.state`                                            | Approval lifecycle segment: `requested`, `approved`, or `denied`                             |
416-| `gen_ai.input.messages`, `gen_ai.output.messages`                                  | Opt-in OTel-schema model messages on `chat`, including tool parts and output finish reasons  |
--
453-written to telemetry metadata or spans.

455:System instructions that the AI SDK presents to the model as a system-role chat
456-message remain in `gen_ai.input.messages`, which OTel explicitly permits for
457-instructions that are part of chat history. The wrapper does not separately
458-copy the raw `system` parameter into `gen_ai.system_instructions`. Schemas,
459-request headers, provider options, and raw error messages are never recorded.
460-The optional AI Gateway reference is a bounded opaque log ID; response headers
461-and provider metadata themselves are not recorded. Metadata and context values
462-must be scalar; objects and arrays are dropped.
463-
464-For v6, only `experimental_context` exists. Configure its allowlist on the
465-wrapper:
466-
467-```ts
468-const traced = wrapAISDK(ai, {
469-  includeRuntimeContext: ["requestId", "tenantId"]
470-});
471-
472-await traced.generateText({
473-  model,
474-  prompt: "Will I need an umbrella?",
475-  experimental_context: {
476-    requestId: "req-123",
477-    tenantId: "tenant-42"
478-  }
479-});
480-```
481-
482-For v7, put application context in `runtimeContext` and select telemetry-visible
483:keys with the AI SDK's boolean-map allowlist:
484-
485-```ts
486-await generateText({
487-  model,
488-  prompt: "Will I need an umbrella?",
489-  runtimeContext: { requestId: "req-123", tenantId: "tenant-42" },
490-  telemetry: {
491-    includeRuntimeContext: {
492-      requestId: true,
493-      tenantId: true
494-    }
495-  }
496-});
497-```
498-
499-Do not include tokens, credentials, user input, or other secrets. Context
500-filtering reduces accidental exposure; it is not a security boundary.

I added tracing to the model call in `src/summarize.js` and turned on traces in `wrangler.jsonc`. I haven't run or built it: the approval prompt for a `wrangler deploy --dry-run` build check came up and the build didn't run.

**`src/summarize.js`**
- It now imports `ai` as a whole module and wraps it with `wrapAISDK` from `agents/observability/ai`, then uses the wrapped `generateText`. According to the `agents` 0.27.0 docs this works with AI SDK v7, and you don't need to register a separate telemetry integration.
- Each call should create an `invoke_agent summarizer` span with a `chat {model}` span inside it. These carry the model name, token usage and response details.
